title: Duplicate charges
text: If a customer was charged twice for the same purchase, propose refunding only the EXTRA duplicate charge, not both charges. Two charges of $49.99 for one purchase imply a proposed refund of $49.99, not $99.98. Actual transactions must be verified before payment.

title: Announced subscription price changes
text: An announced subscription price increase is not automatically refundable. If the customer received prior notice, explain the policy and offer escalation or plan review; do not propose a refund solely because they dislike the new price.

title: Unverified or unclear billing disputes
text: Do not invent amounts or assume customer statements match billing records. If enough detail is missing or no transaction record is available, request verification or manual review before any real refund.

title: Previously refunded charges
text: Never refund the same transaction twice. Check the payment provider's prior refunds and transaction IDs before any real refund.
